Class PoolLink

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.pool.PoolLink
final class PoolLink extends Object
The PoolLink class is one ACP pipe. A local link is the stdin and stdout of grok agent stdio. A remote link is one WebSocket to grok agent serve. Each WebSocket text frame is one JSON-RPC object. The pool still writes one JSON line and reads one JSON line. A newline on the output stream sends that line as one text frame, without the newline. Each inbound text frame is offered to the reader as that text plus a newline. The serve token, when present, is the Authorization header Bearer plus the token. The token is not placed in the URL. The token is not written into an exception message. A failed dial throws IOException with the message spawn.

    • local

      static PoolLink local(Process process)

    • remote

      static PoolLink remote(String url, String secret) throws IOException
      The remote method dials one serve WebSocket. The connect wait is 10 seconds. A blank secret sends no Authorization header.
      Parameters:
      url - The url is ws://host:port/ws. It does not carry the secret.
      secret - The secret is the serve token, or empty.
      Returns:
      The return value is the open link.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception with the message spawn when the dial fails.

    • alive

      boolean alive()
      The alive method reports whether the seat can still carry a turn.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the process is alive, or the socket is still open.

    • exitCode

      int exitCode()
      The exitCode method returns the process exit code. A live process returns -1. A socket returns -1.
      Returns:
      The return value is the exit code, or -1.

    • destroy

      void destroy()
      The destroy method closes the seat. A process is force-stopped and the method waits up to 2 seconds. A socket is closed and then aborted if the close does not finish. An interrupt restores the thread interrupt flag.

    • emptyError

      private static InputStream emptyError()
      The emptyError method returns a stream that is already finished.
      Returns:
      The return value is an empty stream.
